space.label: Playbooks
space.answers: What operating surface should a Persona use to coordinate multiple stages, participants, skills, tools, artifacts, handoffs, gates, recovery, and learning toward an outcome?
space.write: Add or change a playbook only when the work is a reusable multi-stage operating model, not a one-off task.
do_not: Do not copy persona or skill definitions into a playbook when a reference is enough.
Do not treat a Playbook as the actor, domain expert, or autonomous owner of an outcome.

routes.request: Compose a reusable multi-stage operating model
first_reads: Template references when the outcome starts from a reusable artifact
non_triggers: A one-off task with no reusable stages or handoffs
routes.next_handoff: Confirm the operating Persona, then validate linked records, decision rights, gates, recovery, and learning loop before handoff. The Playbook is the process surface; it does not execute or own the work.

routes.request: Coordinate a shared problem across multiple Personas
non_triggers: A request that does not need shared state, attribution, or handoffs
routes.next_handoff: Keep contributions attributable and require a concrete solution-quality gate.

first_reads: active Work Order or GitHub issue
non_triggers: A Multi-Persona Collaboration run that synthesizes one solution from named Personas
A single-workstream implementation that does not need parallel dispatch
Runtime execution, merge, or nested agent spawning as if this Playbook were an executor
routes.next_handoff: After Playbook selection, record the Implementer context as fresh, previously_oriented, or unknown and follow the target repository's current orientation path before source-grounding. For fresh or unknown Implementers, read the target repository's local instructions and documented bootstrap when present; previously oriented Implementers still refresh the current base and relevant scoped instructions/source. Keep orientation state separate from grounding state. Ground each candidate workstream there and classify it confirmed, qualified, or contradicted before dispatch. Dispatch only confirmed or qualified workstreams. Keep the coordinator thin. Give each implementer one workstream, one branch, and one PR, then STOP. Pass compact GitHub-reference handoffs with orientation references/status, not copied repository history. When the runtime supports it, send one compact completion callback to the originating conversation with aggregate run status review_ready, blocked, or deferred plus one terminal status per workstream; aggregate review_ready requires all workstreams review_ready, blocked wins when any workstream is blocked, and otherwise deferred applies when at least one workstream is deferred. For deferred work, record the scoped dependency and re-entry condition; otherwise surface the same packet in the coordinator context and stop. The callback is notification only; review from fresh GitHub state, including problem correctness against current owner/source. Apply scoped corrections and re-review; recording corrections is not terminal. Apply the target repository's pinned GitHub Tool contract for merge authorization and linked-issue completion semantics. Do not nest implementer agents or copy child transcripts into the coordinator. After Playbook selection, execution is grounded in the target repository. For external target repositories, Persona-Library is not an additional execution dependency unless the target repository requires it. If Persona-Library itself is the target repository, follow its own AGENTS.md, bootstrap, and selected route requirements. When the target repository defines standing completion authorization tied to a scoped implementation request, treat that repository contract as a valid Authorizer source after fresh preflight unless the requester explicitly narrows the stopping boundary; green implementation, review, or callback status alone does not create authorization.

routes.request: Research, promote, maintain, or reconcile a reusable Template across stewardship and domain owners
first_reads: active Work Order or GitHub issue
non_triggers: A bounded catalog lookup, research brief, local compose, or read-only reconciliation that does not need cross-owner stages
Copying Template Skills, domain methods, or external starter trees into the Playbook
Treating catalog presence as proof of runtime access, fetch, install, or automatic promotion
routes.next_handoff: Use Elena Park for stewardship coordination. Search the Template catalog before creating. Route substantive quality to the relevant domain specialist. Keep canonical starters in the verified external source such as rickvang/template-library. Promote only with reuse evidence and authorization. After a material lifecycle change, run $template-reconciliation, then one universal $change-impact-reconciliation pass. Escalate architecture or placement questions to Mara Okoye. Do not run this Playbook when a single Template Skill route is sufficient.
